crossRefs.note: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there…
Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed Yahweh’s voice, and have gone the way which Yahweh sent me, and have brought…
if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

translations.web: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
translations.bsb: And the man answered, “The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
translations.kjv: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
translations.asv: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
